# Home

> Enhance your cyber security operations with a comprehensive range of tools and resources for both offensive and defensive strategies.

- [Home](https://infosec.house/readme.md): Home
- [About](https://infosec.house/about.md): Bug reports for broken/incorrect links are best started as an Issue.
- [AI](https://infosec.house/ai.md): Tools and resources for pentesting and securing artificial intelligence systems.
- [API](https://infosec.house/api.md): Tools and resources for pentesting against API endpoints.
- [Assets Management](https://infosec.house/assets-management.md): Keep track of your inventory. You can't protect what you don't see.
- [Blogs & Zines](https://infosec.house/blogs.md): Reading material for offensive security researchers.
- [Bug Bounty](https://infosec.house/bug-bounty.md): Test out your skills against other hackers. Get paid for finding vulnerabilities.
- [C2](https://infosec.house/c2.md): Command and control systems.
- [Changelog](https://infosec.house/changelog.md): Infosec House changelog. See what latest changes have been made!
- [Cheat Sheets](https://infosec.house/cheat-sheets.md): Cheat sheets for Offensive & Defensive Security.
- [Cloud & Containers](https://infosec.house/cloud-containers.md): Discover tools and resources dedicated to hacking cloud platforms.
- [Collaboration](https://infosec.house/collab.md): Discover tools used for red team collaboration.
- [Cracking](https://infosec.house/cracking.md): Everything you need to crack all the hashes.
- [Cryptography](https://infosec.house/cryptography.md): How great is your cryptography?
- [CTF](https://infosec.house/ctf.md): Offensive Security Capture the Flag Events.
- [Data Exfiltration](https://infosec.house/data-exfiltration.md): Exfiltrate the data, and test your DLP.
- [Default Passwords](https://infosec.house/default-passwords.md): The default password library.
- [E-Mail](https://infosec.house/e-mail.md): E-Mail pentesting tools and resources.
- [Editors & Viewers](https://infosec.house/editor-viewer.md): Tools for editing/viewing files.
- [Education](https://infosec.house/education.md): Training and courses to master your craft.
- [Emulation](https://infosec.house/emulation.md): Emulate the adversary.
- [Endpoint Protection](https://infosec.house/endpoint-protection.md): Protect your endpoints.
- [Evasion](https://infosec.house/evasion.md): Evade getting caught.
- [Exploits](https://infosec.house/exploits.md): Gather all your exploits needed to pop that box.
- [Firewalls](https://infosec.house/firewalls.md): Tools & Resources For Attacking and Defending Firewalls.
- [Forensics](https://infosec.house/forensics.md): Uncover the dirty little secrets of a recovered HDD, Image, malware, and more.
- [Hardware](https://infosec.house/hardware.md): Grab some of the most used hardware within the penetration testing industry.
- [Honeypots](https://infosec.house/honeypot.md): Deploy honeypots to catch the ops moves.
- [IDS/IPS](https://infosec.house/ids-ips.md): Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems.
- [Incident Response](https://infosec.house/ir.md): Incident response tools, and resources when alarms pop off.
- [Linux](https://infosec.house/linux.md): Tools and resources for popping those linux boxes.
- [Malware](https://infosec.house/malware.md): All the malware you can wish for to reverse engineer.
- [Mobile](https://infosec.house/mobile.md): Tools & Resources for Defending and Attacking Mobile Applications.
- [Music](https://infosec.house/music.md): Kick back relax and enjoy some entertainment.
- [Network](https://infosec.house/network.md): Tools & Resources For Sniffing The Network and Modifying The Packets.
- [Operating Systems](https://infosec.house/operating-systems.md): Operating system's solely focused for defensive security teams.
- [Operation Security](https://infosec.house/opsec.md): Seek out technologies and methods of remaining anonymous in the day and age of mass surveillance.
- [OSINT](https://infosec.house/osint.md): Open-Source Intel. Get all the information needed for your target.
- [Privilege Escalation](https://infosec.house/privilege-escalation.md): Reverse engineering tools both offensive and defensive operations can utilize.
- [Reconnaissance](https://infosec.house/recon.md): Understand your target. Perform in-depth research and discover new attack surfaces.
- [Reverse Engineering](https://infosec.house/re.md): Reverse engineering tools both offensive and defensive operations can utilize.
- [Shells](https://infosec.house/shells.md): Generating pre-built webshells to customizing your own.
- [Social Engineering](https://infosec.house/social-engineering.md): Manipulation techniques that exploits human error to gain private information, access, or valuables.
- [Support Us](https://infosec.house/support-us.md): Support Infosec House by donations, sponsorship, or partnership.
- [Threat Intel](https://infosec.house/threat-intel.md): Discover where the threats begin.
- [Videos](https://infosec.house/videos.md): Talks, live-streams, and presentations.
- [Vulnerability Scanners](https://infosec.house/vuln-scanners.md): Discover vulnerabilities fast, and automate some of the heavy loads.
- [Web Applications](https://infosec.house/web-app.md): Break that web application.
- [Windows](https://infosec.house/windows.md): Microsoft Windows pentesting tools and resources.
- [Wireless](https://infosec.house/wireless.md): Discover tools and resources for exploiting Wi-Fi, bluetooth, RFID, and more.
